objective: Remove the optimizer mismatch from the 14-row retrospective Oracle and close the Qwen seq128 and Liger evidence boundaries.

optimizer.name: AdamW
optimizer.common_state_rule: candidate and repair use identical pre-step moments for each same-state comparison

oracle.score: prefix16 local effective-update coherence under the frozen AdamW protocol
oracle.confirmation: full32 local effective-update persistence under the same AdamW protocol

phi_matched_intervention.matching: rescale each stochastic effective-update error to the natural arm's per-step L2 norm
phi_matched_intervention.interpretation: an update-space matched analysis, not a second executable kernel
